descriptions: Fixed a character that logged out dead or in last stand spawning alive on Qbox, because qbx_medical only restores the saved death while LocalPlayer.state.isLoggedIn is true and qf_identity holds that back until the character stands in the world
Fixed isdead staying true in the character metadata on a character that spawned at full health, which told qbx_police, qbx_hud, illenium-appearance and third party scripts that the player was down
Fixed a downed character being offered the spawn selector, it now comes back down where it went down
Added Config.Spawn.RestoreDeathState, set it to false to clear isdead and inlaststand while the character loads so it logs in healthy
